name: Lelisu LS-257 Wireless Stereo Headphones | Bluetooth 5.4 Over-Ear Headset with Type-C Charging & LED Lights
description:
Experience immersive audio and stylish design with the Lelisu LS-257 Wireless Stereo Headphones. Equipped with Bluetooth 5.4 and stable single reception, these headphones deliver smooth, low-latency sound for music, gaming, and calls. Type-C fast charging ensures long playtime, while cushioned ear pads and an adjustable headband provide comfort during extended use. LED lights add a modern, trendy touch, making this headset perfect for entertainment or work.
Key Features
 Bluetooth 5.4 for fast and stable pairing
 Stable single reception with uninterrupted audio
 Deep bass stereo sound with crisp clarity
 Type-C fast charging for extended playtime
 LED illumination for a stylish modern look
 Over-ear cushioned comfort with adjustable headband
 Built-in microphone for clear calls and voice support
 Universal compatibility with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and gaming devices
How to Use
 Turn on Bluetooth on your device and headset
 Pair headset via Bluetooth 5.4 connection
 Adjust headband and ear pads for comfort
 Use controls for music, calls, and LED lighting
Material
ABS Plastic, Synthetic Leather, Foam Cushions
Safety Information
 Do not expose to water or excessive moisture
 Avoid dropping or applying strong impact
 Keep out of reach of children
 Use at moderate volume to protect hearing
Package Includes
 1 × Lelisu LS-257 Wireless Stereo Headphones
 1 × Type-C Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
